create_FileAudioDataset_from_manifest: create a FileAudioDataset from a manifest file with audio file paths and sample sizes
postprocess_audio_features: postprocess audio waveform features by converting stereo to mono and applying layer normalization
collate_audio_samples: collate a batch of audio samples into padded tensors with optional padding masks
crop_audio_to_max_size: crop an audio waveform tensor to a target size using random start position sampling
get_ordered_indices_for_batching: get ordered indices for batching audio samples sorted by size with optional shuffling
